explanation: В двойных кавычках выполняется подстановка переменных и обработка escape-последовательностей (\n, \t и др.), тогда как одинарные кавычки интерпретируют содержимое буквально, поэтому различие функциональное, а не только по скорости.
The null coalescing operator ?? in PHP uses isset-like semantics, silently handling undefined variables without emitting notices or warnings.
echo is a language construct that accepts multiple comma-separated arguments and outputs them consecutively without any separator.
In PHP, print always returns the integer 1, unlike echo, so it can be used within expressions (e.g., $x = print "hello";).
The Elvis operator (?:) returns the left operand if it is TRUTHY, and the right operand if it is falsy — the opposite of the statement.
In PHP 8, the precedence of the concatenation operator (.) was raised to be HIGHER than addition and subtraction, not lower.
The ** operator in PHP is right-associative, so 2 ** 3 ** 2 evaluates as 2 ** (3 ** 2) = 2 ** 9 = 512, not 64.
In PHP 8, '.' has higher precedence than '+', so it evaluates as ('сумма: ' . 2) + 3; the non-numeric string 'сумма: 2' is coerced to 0 (with a warning), giving 0 + 3 = 3.
In PHP, arrays compared with === must have the same key/value pairs in the same order; changing the order of elements makes them not strictly equal.
0 == false возвращает true, а оператор == — это нестрогое (свободное) сравнение, при котором оба значения приводятся к одинаковому типу; строгое сравнение используется оператором ===.
In PHP 8, non-numeric strings compared to integers are no longer cast to 0; instead the integer is cast to string, so "abc" == 0 evaluates to "abc" == "0", which is false.
In PHP, null == 0, null == "", and null == false all evaluate to true because null is loosely coerced to each of these values in non-strict comparisons.
При приведении строки к int PHP читает символы слева направо, пока они являются цифрами, и останавливается на первом нечисловом символе, поэтому '42abc' становится 42.
В PHP оператор + приводит строку '5' к числу, и получается арифметическое сложение 5 + 5 = 10.
In PHP, casting boolean false to a string produces an empty string "", not "0"; only true becomes "1".
Due to IEEE 754 floating-point representation, 0.1 + 0.2 yields 0.30000000000000004, so the === comparison with 0.3 returns false.
strrev() reverses strings byte-by-byte, which corrupts multi-byte UTF-8 characters; it is only safe for single-byte (ASCII) strings.
str_contains checks if the second argument exists as a substring in the first argument, and 'world' is present in 'Hello world', so it returns true.
str_pad() поддерживает дополнание строки слева (STR_PAD_LEFT), справа (STR_PAD_RIGHT, значение по умолчанию) и с обеих сторон (STR_PAD_BOTH).
By default, trim() strips all whitespace characters including spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, null bytes, and vertical tabs.
strlen() в PHP считает байты, а в UTF-8 каждый из 6 кириллических символов кодируется 2 байтами: 6×2=12.
substr with a negative start (-3) counts from the end of the string, so it returns the last 3 characters: 'def'.
In PHP, strings are immutable and passed by value, so ucfirst() returns a new string with the first character uppercased and does not modify the original string in-place.
In PHP, heredoc syntax interpolates variables (like double quotes), while nowdoc syntax (enclosed in single quotes) does not interpolate variables (like single quotes).
sort() assigns new integer keys (0, 1, 2, ...) to the elements, discarding the original keys; asort() is the function that preserves key-value associations.
In PHP, numeric string array keys like '5' are automatically cast to integers (5) during array key type juggling.
By default in_array() uses loose comparison (==); strict comparison (===) is only used when the third parameter $strict is set to true.
By default, array_filter() without a callback uses a filter that removes all elements whose value evaluates to false (e.g., 0, "", null, false, empty array).
By default array_slice() reindexes numeric keys starting from 0; you must pass preserve_keys=true to keep them.
array_slice([10,20,30,40], 1, 2) starts at offset 1 (value 20) and takes 2 elements, yielding [20, 30].
The + operator in PHP performs an array union, keeping existing keys from the left operand; 'a' stays as 1, 'b' => 2 is added, resulting in 2 elements.
PHP 8.1 introduced array unpacking with spread operator, and unlike argument unpacking (PHP 7.4), it supports both integer and string keys.
In PHP 8.0+, named arguments can be freely combined with array unpacking (...$args) in a single function call, e.g. foo(...$args, key: $value).
In PHP, anonymous functions (closures) do NOT capture outer scope variables; they must be explicitly imported using the `use` keyword.
func_num_args() возвращает количество фактических аргументов, переданных при вызове функции, независимо от количества параметров в её объявлении.
Arrow functions (fn) in PHP can only have a single expression as their body; they do not support curly braces with multiple statements (unlike regular closures).
Стрелочные функции fn захватывают переменные из внешней области по ЗНАЧЕНИЮ и привязка происходит в момент создания функции (eagerly), а не лениво по ссылке.
A static closure in PHP does not bind $this to the enclosing scope, so $this is unavailable inside it.
The closure captures $x by value at creation time (5), so reassigning $x to 7 later does not affect the captured value.
In PHP's coercive (weak) mode, a numeric string like "5" is silently converted to int 5 when passed to an int-typed parameter.

Constructor property promotion is a feature introduced in PHP 8.0 that allows visibility modifiers (public/protected/private) on constructor parameters, automatically creating and assigning properties.
The 'final' keyword in PHP prevents a method from being overridden in subclasses.
В PHP ключевое слово final на уровне метода действительно запрещает его переопределение в подклассах.
Private properties in PHP are accessible only within the declaring class and are not visible to subclasses.
Anonymous class internal name in PHP is 'class@anonymous\0/file/path...', so the part before the null byte is 'class@anonymous'.

Private methods are not inherited and do not participate in the method resolution chain, so a child class is free to declare a method with the same name using any visibility (public, protected, or private).
__get() is called not only for non-existent properties but also for existing but inaccessible (private/protected) properties accessed from outside the class.
Повторное присваивание readonly-свойства в PHP 8.1+ бросает Error, а не Exception.
In PHP, interfaces can declare constants (e.g., const or define-like constant members), though they cannot declare properties or concrete methods.
In PHP, the instanceof operator checks whether an object is an instance of a given class or implements a given interface.
In PHP, interfaces can declare static method signatures (e.g., `public static function foo();`), and implementing classes must provide the corresponding static method.
instanceof checks both class inheritance and interface implementation in PHP, so the statement is false.
В PHP методы интерфейса не могут иметь реализацию по умолчанию — они объявляются только как сигнатуры, в отличие от трейтов, которые допускают тела методов.
In PHP, abstract methods can have public or protected visibility (but not private), so protected is allowed.
Foo::cases() возвращает массив из всех трёх case-элементов: A, B и C.
Starting from PHP 8.2, traits can declare constants.
In PHP 7+, both Exception and Error implement the Throwable interface, making it their common ancestor.
TypeError inherits from Error, not Exception; the common parent is the Throwable interface, so catch(Exception $e) does not catch TypeError.
The @ operator suppresses errors (warnings, notices) but does NOT suppress exceptions; exceptions must be handled with try/catch.
intdiv() throws a DivisionByZeroError exception when the divisor is zero.
The finally block in PHP executes regardless of whether an exception was thrown, caught, or not, making it the last block to run in a try-catch-finally structure.
An exception thrown inside a finally block replaces the original exception (or return value) from the try/catch and propagates to the caller, thus affecting the result of the try block.
In PHP, casting any object to bool always returns true, regardless of the object's content.
In PHP, functions registered via register_shutdown_function() are called at the end of script execution, which includes when exit() or die() is invoked.

The `use` statement only creates a namespace alias for the parser; it does not load any file. The actual class file is loaded by an autoloader (e.g., Composer's PSR-4) or by explicit `require`/`include` calls.
To import a function in PHP you write `use function Some\Namespace\funcName;`, while `const` is used for importing constants.
PSR-4 maps the App\ namespace prefix to src/, so App\Controller\Api\UserController becomes src/Controller/Api/UserController.php.
Composer's vendor/autoload.php invokes spl_autoload_register() to register its classmap, PSR-4, and PSR-0 autoloaders.
The magic constant __NAMESPACE__ in PHP returns the fully qualified name of the current namespace, or an empty string if in the global namespace.
Relative class names in PHP resolve relative to the current namespace, not the global root; only fully qualified names (with leading backslash) resolve from the global root.
В PSR-4 префикс 'App\' заменяется на 'src/', а остальная часть 'Model\User' становится 'src/Model/User.php', что соответствует утверждению.
В PHP директива `use` для импорта пространств имён допустима только на верхнем уровне (вне функций, классов и методов); внутри тела функции она вызовет фатальную ошибку.
In PHP, arrays are assigned by value (copied), not by reference, unless the & operator is explicitly used to pass by reference.
In PHP, arrays are copied by value, so modifying $b does not affect $a, which still has 2 elements.
In PHP, global variables are not accessible inside functions unless explicitly made available via the `global` keyword, the `$GLOBALS` superglobal, or passed as arguments.
unset($GLOBALS['x']) modifies the actual global scope since $GLOBALS is a superglobal referencing the real global variables, so the variable is destroyed globally, not only within the function.
The function parameter is passed by reference (&), so $x++ modifies $n directly, changing it from 5 to 6.
При итерации по значению foreach работает с копией массива (начиная с PHP 5), поэтому добавление/удаление элементов внутри цикла не влияет на текущий проход.
Static properties belong to the class itself and are shared across all instances, so a change made through one object is visible in all others.
In PHP, boolean keys are automatically converted to integers (true→1, false→0), so they are never stored as bool in an array.
В PHP 5.5+ в генераторе можно использовать return со значением, а начиная с PHP 7.0 это значение доступно через метод Generator::getReturn() после исчерпания всех yield.
Once a generator has started yielding values, calling rewind() throws a LogicException ('Cannot rewind a generator that was started'), so an exhausted generator cannot be restarted.
В PHP конструкция `yield from` действительно делегирует генерацию значений другому генератору или итерируемому объекту, передавая все его значения наружу.
A function containing yield returns a Generator object when called, so get_class() returns the string "Generator".
The generator yields 1, 2, 3; iterator_to_array converts them to a 3-element array; count returns 3.
SplStack implements a LIFO (Last In, First Out) stack; FIFO is implemented by SplQueue.
ArrayIterator is an SPL class that wraps an array and implements the Iterator interface, enabling traversal via foreach or Iterator methods.
ArrayObject implements IteratorAggregate, so it CAN be iterated with foreach.
password_hash() automatically generates a cryptographically secure salt and embeds it in the returned hash string, so no separate salt parameter is needed.
PASSWORD_DEFAULT in PHP 8 uses bcrypt (or Argon2i), not md5; md5 is never used for password hashing in PHP's password_* functions.
password_verify returns true when the given password matches the hash, which is the case here since the hash was generated from the same 'secret' string.
strip_tags() only removes HTML and PHP tags from a string and provides no protection against SQL injection, which requires parameterized queries or proper SQL escaping.
session_regenerate_id() generates a new session ID upon login, which is the standard defense against session fixation attacks.
The built-in function php_sapi_name() returns the name of the SAPI module under which PHP is running, e.g. 'cli', 'apache2handler', etc.
session_destroy() only removes the session data stored on the server; the session cookie (containing the session ID) remains in the browser until explicitly unset or expired via setcookie().
Without session_start(), $_SESSION is not populated with session data; the session must be explicitly started to load previously saved data into the superglobal array.
Функция array_find() была добавлена в PHP 8.4 вместе с array_any() и array_all().
Property hooks (get/set blocks defined directly in the property declaration) are one of the major new features introduced in PHP 8.4.
Asymmetric property visibility (e.g., `public private(set)`) was introduced in PHP 8.4 via an accepted RFC.
The #[\NoDiscard] attribute was introduced in PHP 8.1 to warn when a function's return value is discarded.
The pipe operator |> was never introduced in any released version of PHP; it was only proposed via RFC and not accepted.
Синтаксис clone($obj, ['x' => 1]) (clone-with) не был принят ни в одной версии PHP; соответствующий RFC так и не был реализован.
Functions array_first() and array_last() do not exist in any version of PHP; the closest equivalents are array_key_first()/array_key_last() (PHP 7.3) and reset()/end().
RFC Partial Function Application v2 был предложен для PHP 8.2.
RFC clamp_v2 для функции clamp() была реализована в PHP 8.3 (выпущен 23 ноября 2023).
The Context Managers RFC (including v2) was proposed and discussed in PHP but was not accepted/passed as of that date.
The RFC for Bound-Erased Generic Types was actually voted on and rejected earlier (around 2025), not in 2026.
As of PHP 8.4 (November 2024) and within my knowledge, no RFC to enable ZTS (Zend Thread Safety) by default has been accepted; NTS remains the default build mode.
Generics (parameterized types) have never been implemented in PHP and are still absent in PHP 8.5.
PHP follows an annual release cycle around late November, so on 07.11.2026 PHP 8.5 (released Nov 2025) is the latest stable, and PHP 8.6 (GA ~19.11.2026) has not yet been released.
PHP 6 was abandoned due to unresolved Unicode issues and performance problems, and PHP 7.0 followed directly after PHP 5.6 in 2015.
The RFC to add the #[\Deprecated] attribute was accepted and it was implemented in PHP 8.4.

Both in Clean Architecture and Onion Architecture the dependency rule states that source code dependencies must point inward (toward the core/domain), so inner layers have no knowledge of outer layers.

В доменном слое (по принципам DDD / Clean Architecture) сущности должны быть чистыми и не зависеть от Doctrine, Symfony или иных фреймворков/библиотек — только от языка PHP и его стандартной библиотеки.
Контроллеры и Twig-шаблоны относятся к слою представления (interface/presentation layer), а не к слою бизнес-логики, хотя они и вызывают use cases.
В луковичной архитектуре (onion architecture) в самом центре находится доменный слой — ядро бизнес-логики приложения.

Deptrac и подобные анализаторы зависимостей (например, PHPAT, ArchUnit) автоматически проверяют, что вызовы не нарушают заданные правила слоёв, и завершают работу с ошибкой при запрещённой зависимости.

In Clean/Hexagonal Architecture a use case must depend only on simple DTOs and abstract repository interfaces, never on framework-specific details like an HTTP request (web adapter) or an EntityManager (persistence adapter).
В Domain-Driven Design репозиторий (Repository) представляет коллекцию агрегатов/сущностей, инкапсулируя механизм хранения за абстрактным интерфейсом.

In Clean Architecture, the database is an implementation detail in the outermost layer (Frameworks & Drivers), while use cases depend only on abstractions (ports/interfaces), so swapping PostgreSQL for another DB does not affect domain or use-case code.
An Aggregate in DDD is a cluster of domain entities and value objects treated as a single consistency boundary, not a database table.
Value Object в DDD действительно неизменяем (immutable) и два экземпляра равны, если все их поля совпадают, без использования идентификатора.
В DDD корень агрегата — это единственная точка входа, через которую все изменения внутри агрегата должны проходить.
In DDD, a repository is defined for the aggregate root as the sole entry point for retrieving and persisting the entire aggregate, not for individual entities within it.
Ubiquitous Language from DDD is indeed a common, unified language shared between developers and domain experts for modeling the domain.
In PHP, a namespace is the boundary within which a class name and its definition are unified; outside that namespace, the same name refers to a different model.

DDD explicitly advocates a rich domain model where objects encapsulate both data and behavior; the anemic model is considered an anti-pattern (described by Martin Fowler and Eric Evans as contrary to DDD principles).
В DDD bounded context действительно означает, что каждая граница имеет свою модель, и одно и то же понятие домена может быть представлено разными классами в разных контекстах.
In Symfony's DI container, services are lazily instantiated by default, meaning they are created only when first requested/accessed.
The command `bin/console debug:router` lists all registered routes in a Symfony application.

Autowiring in Symfony automatically resolves and injects dependencies based on type hints, eliminating the need to manually list each service; a single _defaults block with autowire: true and a resource directive covers all classes in a namespace.
Twig compiles each template into a PHP class on first render and stores the compiled result in a filesystem cache for reuse across subsequent requests.
В Symfony dev-окружении контейнер DI кэшируется и пересобирается только при изменении отслеживаемых ресурсов (конфигурации, аннотации и т.д.), а не на каждом запросе.
Переменная окружения APP_ENV определяет активное окружение Symfony (dev, prod, test и т.д.).
Symfony controller action methods must be public; private or protected methods cannot be invoked by the routing/dispatcher.

События распределяются между слушателями и подписчиками исключительно по приоритету (priority); интерфейс EventSubscriberInterface сам по себе не даёт никакого приоритета — диспетчер просто собирает все обработчики в один общий массив и сортирует по priority.
In Symfony 6.0 the old Guard system was completely removed and replaced by the new authenticator system based on AuthenticatorInterface (introduced in Symfony 5.3).
The #[IsGranted] attribute from Symfony\Component\Security\Http\Attribute\IsGranted checks the user's role or permission on a controller method; if denied, it returns a 403 Forbidden response.
Voters (голосующие) in Symfony's Security component are indeed the mechanism for object-level access checks, and isGranted('EDIT', $post) is the standard syntax for invoking them.
Symfony 7.0 removed support for docblock annotations; validation constraints are now declared exclusively via PHP attributes (#[Assert\NotBlank]).
В Symfony опция csrf_protection для форм по умолчанию установлена в true, поэтому токен генерируется при создании формы и проверяется автоматически при отправке.
Symfony always performs server-side validation independently; HTML5 client-side checks are bypassable and never replace it.
The Symfony MakerBundle command 'make:form' generates a new form type class extending AbstractType.

Symfony does not store the plaintext password in the session; after authentication, only user identity data (username, roles, etc.) is persisted in the session token, while the password is used solely for credential verification and is never kept in plaintext.
In Symfony 4+ (microkernel), bundle configuration files are indeed stored one per bundle or topic in config/packages/, e.g., framework.yaml, twig.yaml, doctrine.yaml.
В стандартной конвенции Laravel/Symfony сам файл .env gitignore-ится, а с дефолтами в репозиторий коммитится .env.example.
The `bin/console debug:container` command lists all registered services in the Symfony DI container along with their aliases.
The setParameter() method works at runtime from a controller, modifying the container's parameter bag after it has been compiled.
Начиная с Symfony 4.0 (и фактически с 3.3+) все сервисы по умолчанию приватны (public: false), чтобы получать их напрямую из контейнера нужно явно указывать public: true.
Многие бандлы Symfony работают с конфигурацией по умолчанию, определяемой в их Extension, и не требуют обязательного файла в config/packages.
В Symfony начиная с версии 3.3 значения переменных окружения действительно подставляются в services.yaml синтаксисом %env(VAR)%.
APP_DEBUG is the Symfony environment variable that enables debug mode, activating the Web Debug Toolbar, profiler, and Twig debugging.
In Symfony Messenger, a single message can be handled by multiple handlers; you can register several #[AsMessageHandler] methods for the same message type and all of them will be invoked.
The sync transport processes the message immediately and inline in the current process, unlike async which enqueues the message for a worker to handle.
In Symfony Messenger, the console command `messenger:consume` launches a worker that processes messages from configured transport queues.
In Symfony Messenger, retry_strategy can be configured directly under a transport definition (e.g., in messenger.yaml under the transport's retry_strategy key).
Symfony Messenger by default uses the Symfony Serializer component with a JSON encoder to serialize messages before sending them to a transport.
Symfony Scheduler (since 6.1) generates scheduled messages (e.g., RunMessage with a CronSchedule or Interval) and dispatches them through the Messenger bus, where handlers execute the actual tasks.
Symfony Messenger provides a built-in 'doctrine' transport that stores messages in database tables via Doctrine DBAL/ORM.
Symfony Messenger allows registering custom middleware in the pipeline and positioning them before or after built-in ones via the messenger configuration.
Symfony major releases (e.g., 5.0, 6.0, 7.0) are indeed planned every two years, and minor releases (e.g., 6.1, 6.2) are published every six months, in May and November.
Symfony 8 requires a minimum PHP version of 8.3.
Symfony 7.0 removed support for annotations in docblocks; PHP 8 attributes are now the only supported way to define routes, validation constraints, etc.
Symfony AssetMapper (introduced in 6.3) manages CSS/JS assets without Node.js or webpack, relying on the importmap.php file to define browser-native import maps.
Symfony 6.4 is an LTS (Long Term Support) release, not a regular one — LTS versions in Symfony are 4.4, 5.4, 6.4, 7.4, etc.
В Symfony по политике семантического версионирования деприкейшены, введённые в минорных версиях, удаляются при переходе на следующую мажорную версию.
Each Symfony major release includes an UPGRADE-*.md guide documenting all breaking changes, deprecations, and migration steps.
The Symfony AssetMapper component (symfony/asset-mapper), introduced in Symfony 6.3, manages assets and provides a native importmap feature without requiring Node.js or Webpack.
Symfony 8.2 is expected around late November 2026 (following the typical ~Nov 22–28 release pattern), so it would not yet be available on November 7, 2026.
In the six-month cycle starting with Symfony 8.0 in May 2026, November 2026 would bring Symfony 8.1, while Symfony 8.2 is expected in May 2027.
Symfony follows a minor version release cycle, so the next version after 8.1 is 8.2.

Symfony 8.2 is a minor release (the second digit indicates a minor version), which is backward-compatible and does not require rewriting applications; only major releases like 8.0 introduce breaking API changes.
PHP 8.1 → 8.2 is a minor version bump within the same major (8.x) line, and by PHP's versioning policy backward compatibility is maintained across minor releases.
Symfony follows a 2-year major cadence with 6-month minors (e.g., 5.0→5.4→6.0, 6.0→6.4→7.0), so the last 8.x minor before 9.0 is 8.4.

Symfony does not raise its PHP requirement mid-major-version (e.g., from 8.0 to 8.2); the minimum PHP is set at the start of a major release cycle, and PHP 8.5 was not even planned as a hard dependency for any Symfony 8.x minor release.
Symfony's policy states that deprecations introduced in a major version (e.g., 8.x) will be removed no earlier than the next major version (9.0).
Twig does not allow arbitrary PHP code inside {{ }}; only Twig expressions, functions, and filters are permitted, and raw PHP tags are not executed within templates.
Twig включит автоэкранирование по умолчанию для всех переменных, выводимых через {{ }}, чтобы защитить от XSS.
The |e (shorthand for |escape) filter in Twig defaults to the 'html' context, escaping characters like <, >, &, " for safe HTML output.
Фильтр number_format из twig/intl-extra использует PHP NumberFormatter для форматирования чисел с учётом локали.
In Twig, the |raw filter marks a value as safe, effectively disabling auto-escaping so the content is output verbatim.
In Twig, {{ }} outputs expressions and {% %} handles control-flow tags like if, for, and set.
В Twig можно объявлять переменные прямо в шаблоне с помощью тега {% set variable = value %}.
The Twig function dump() outputs a human-readable debug representation of a variable's structure, requiring the Twig Debug extension.
Bootstrap — это фреймворк готовых CSS/JS-компонентов (сетки, кнопки, модальные окна и т.д.), а не SPA-фреймворк вроде React или Angular.
Класс .container в Bootstrap создаёт адаптивный контейнер с фиксированной максимальной шириной, определяемой по брейкпоинтам.
Bootstrap's grid system divides a row into 12 columns, not 16 (though the use of CSS floats is true for Bootstrap 3 and earlier, while Bootstrap 4/5 use flexbox).
В Bootstrap 5 именованные брейкпоинты с инфиксом действительно пять: sm, md, lg, xl, xxl (xs не имеет инфикса).
In frameworks like Bootstrap and Tailwind, the numeric suffix in spacing utilities (e.g., .mt-3, .px-2) indexes a spacing scale where each step is a multiple of the base $spacer variable.
In Bootstrap 5, the data-bs-toggle attribute is used to activate interactive components like dropdowns, modals, and collapse on elements.
Bootstrap 5 полностью отказался от зависимости jQuery и переписал все компоненты на чистом vanilla JavaScript.
In Bootstrap 5.3, dark mode is enabled via the `data-bs-theme="dark"` attribute on the root element, not a `.dark` class.
Doctrine ORM does not automatically create tables at runtime; schema must be explicitly created/updated via CLI commands like `doctrine:schema:update --force` or via migrations.
EntityManager::persist() marks a new entity as managed in the Unit of Work, but the INSERT SQL is only issued during flush().
В Doctrine ORM 3 метод EntityManager::merge() был удалён из интерфейса, а в Doctrine ORM 2 он также не делал переданный объект управляемым, а создавал управляемую копию.
DQL operates on entity classes and their mapped fields, not on raw database table and column names, which is a core design principle of Doctrine ORM.
Метод find() в Doctrine ORM возвращает null, если сущность с указанным идентификатором не найдена.
DoctrineBundle does not automatically call flush() at the end of each request; the developer must explicitly call $entityManager->flush() or use transactional annotations/service to persist changes.

В Doctrine ORM сущность уже находится в Managed состоянии (например, загружена через find()), и UnitOfWork хранит её исходный снимок (snapshot); при flush() выполняется dirty-checking, и изменения фиксируются в БД без повторного вызова persist().
В Doctrine ORM remove() только помечает сущность для удаления в Unit of Work, а фактический SQL DELETE выполняется при вызове flush().
MVCC in PostgreSQL specifically ensures that readers do NOT block writers and writers do NOT block readers, which is the core advantage over traditional lock-based concurrency control.
The EXPLAIN command displays the execution plan of a SQL query without actually running it.

SERIAL — это синтаксический сахар (DEFAULT nextval), а GENERATED ... AS IDENTITY — это стандартный SQL-механизм, где последовательность принадлежит колонке на уровне метаданных; они ведут себя по-разному при удалении колонки, переопределении значения и т.д.
По умолчанию PostgreSQL в ограничении UNIQUE трактует NULL как отличное от NULL (NULLS DISTINCT), поэтому допускает множество строк с NULL в столбце.
string_agg(expression, delimiter) is the PostgreSQL aggregate function that concatenates strings with a specified separator.
Ordinary VACUUM only marks dead tuple space as reusable within the table; it does not return space to the operating system (that is VACUUM FULL or, since PG12, limited trailing-page truncation).
Ключевое слово PARTITION BY в предложении OVER разбивает строки на группы, для каждой из которых вычисляется оконная функция.
READ COMMITTED protects only against dirty reads, but does not prevent non-repeatable reads; that level of protection is provided by REPEATABLE READ.
By default PostgreSQL has autocommit enabled, so each standalone SQL statement is wrapped in its own implicit transaction and committed immediately unless an explicit BEGIN/COMMIT block is used.
The COMMIT command permanently saves all changes made during the current transaction.
Indexes help the engine locate target rows via the WHERE clause, speeding up UPDATE and DELETE just as they speed up SELECT.
PostgreSQL uses SAVEPOINT to create named points within a transaction, allowing partial rollback of subsequent statements while preserving earlier work.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE actually executes the query and shows the plan along with real timing information, unlike plain EXPLAIN which only shows the plan without execution.
Расширение pgvector (vector) добавляет типы данных vector, halfvec, sparsevec и индексы HNSW/IVFFlat для поиска по векторным эмбеддингам в PostgreSQL.
A partial index (with a WHERE clause) indeed contains only the rows that satisfy the specified condition, unlike a full index which covers all rows.

В PostgreSQL уровень SERIALIZABLE реализован через Serializable Snapshot Isolation (SSI) на основе MVCC и предикатных блокировок, а не через блокировку строк при чтении; обычный SELECT не захватывает построчных блокировок даже на уровне SERIALIZABLE.
HTTP-статус 201 (Created) действительно означает, что запрос привёл к успешному созданию нового ресурса.
HTTP 204 No Content indicates a successful request with no body in the response, commonly used for DELETE operations.
According to RFC 7231, DELETE is explicitly listed as an idempotent method: repeated requests on the same resource yield the same final state (resource removed or 404 if already gone).
Заголовок Access-Control-Allow-Origin отправляет сервер (а не клиент) в ответе, чтобы разрешить браузеру принимать ответ с другого origin.
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests is indeed defined (RFC 6585) to indicate that the client has exceeded a rate-limiting threshold.
4xx codes indicate client-side errors (e.g., 404, 400), while 5xx codes indicate server-side errors (e.g., 500, 503); the statement reverses them.
The Content-Type header specifies the MIME type of the body of the request or response.
RFC 5789 explicitly states that PATCH is not required to be idempotent, while RFC 7231 mandates that PUT must be idempotent.

Сравнение через == уязвимо к атакам type juggling (например, 'magic hashes' вида '0e...'), а корректная проверка пароля в PHP должна использовать функцию password_verify(), которая выполняет сравнение за константное время и предотвращает timing-атаки.
CSRF-токен действительно генерируется сервером, привязывается к сессии пользователя и проверяется при небезопасных HTTP-методах (POST, PUT, DELETE и т.д.).
CSP is delivered via the 'Content-Security-Policy' HTTP response header.
OAuth 2.0 is an authorization protocol, not authentication; an access token grants resource access but does not identify the user—identity is handled by OpenID Connect (OIDC) on top of OAuth 2.0.

XSS is properly prevented by output encoding/escaping when rendering data in the browser (e.g., htmlspecialchars()), not solely by input validation before database storage; validation alone is insufficient and can be bypassed.
В authorization code flow параметр 'code' (authorization code) приходит на redirect_uri и затем обменивается на access-токен через запрос к token endpoint.
Refresh-токены имеют больший срок жизни и предназначены именно для получения новых access-токенов без повторной аутентификации пользователя.
Соль не является секретом — она хранится рядом с хешем (часто в том же поле) и нужна именно для проверки пароля, а не для его сокрытия.
PHPUnit only discovers and executes test methods in classes that extend PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase (or implement its Test interface); arbitrary classes are ignored by the runner.
setUp() is called before EACH test method, not once before all tests; setUpBeforeClass() is the static method called once before all tests in a class.
Data provider in PHPUnit allows running a test with multiple sets of arguments, returning an array of arrays where each inner array is one set of arguments.
Метод expectException() в PHPUnit задаёт ожидание исключения определённого класса (например, $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class)).
Всё наоборот: stub только подставляет данные (возвращает заранее заданные значения), а mock проверяет поведение — какие именно методы и с какими аргументами были вызваны.
In PHPUnit 10+, the #[DataProvider] attribute is the recommended way to specify data providers, and the @dataProvider annotation is deprecated.
PHPUnit supports test dependencies via the @depends annotation (or #[Depends] attribute), allowing a test to declare it depends on another test passing successfully.
PHPUnit option --random-order (or --order-by=random in newer versions) runs test cases in a random order.
